firewall.login_required: Sign in to a RemoteOS Server to manage its firewall.
firewall.warning: Firewall changes can disconnect this RemoteOS session. Confirm your management access before applying a rule.

password_dialog.title: Confirm firewall change
password_dialog.message: This operation changes the host firewall. Enter the current signed-in account password to continue.

rule.help: Select a rule, then choose Update to edit it. Leave source, destination, or port blank for any; use a single port or a range such as 443 or 8000:8080.
rule.source_tooltip: Enter the client source address to match. Leave blank for any, or enter an IP or CIDR such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24, or 2001:db8::/32.
rule.destination_tooltip: Enter the host destination address to match. Leave blank for any, or enter an IP or CIDR such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24, or 2001:db8::/32.

validation.address_invalid: Source and destination must be any or a valid IP/CIDR, such as 192.0.2.10 or 2001:db8::/32.
validation.port_invalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, or a start:end range.

permission.read_required: Firewall access requires the Read firewall configuration permission.
permission.manage_required: Changing the firewall requires the Manage firewall configuration permission.
